t.zh: 第四步。头两句已知来自：G 说「对角 ⌜D⌝ 证不出」，而对角 ⌜D⌝ 算出来是 ⌜G⌝。Prov 来自：有一个通过检查的证明。真正的定理里，Prov 要用加法和乘法写成一句算术的话，这一步很长，这里当作已知。第三句是可靠：证得出的都是真的（这里只对 G 用到）。
t.en: The fourth step. The first two givens come from : G says “the diagonal of ⌜D⌝ cannot be proved”, and the diagonal of ⌜D⌝ works out to ⌜G⌝. Prov comes from : there is a proof that passes the check. In the real theorem Prov must be written as a sentence of arithmetic, with addition and multiplication; that long step is taken as given here. The third given is soundness: what can be proved is true (used here for G alone).

after.zh: 这是哥德尔第一<wiki-ref to="incompleteness"></wiki-ref>的核心。<level-ref to="kk-one"></level-ref>的说谎者谈真假，推出矛盾；G 谈证不证得出，得到的是一句证不出的真话。
after.en: This is the heart of Gödel’s first <wiki-ref to="incompleteness"></wiki-ref>. The liar of <level-ref to="kk-one"></level-ref> speaks of truth and yields a contradiction; G speaks of proof and yields a truth that cannot be proved.

brief.zh: 从这三句已知证出：G 成立，而且 G 证不出。
brief.en: From these three givens, prove: G holds, and G cannot be proved.

hint.zh: 头两句合起来，说的是 G 和「⌜G⌝ 证不出」的关系。
hint.en: The first two givens together relate G to “⌜G⌝ cannot be proved”.

hint.zh: 先证 G 证不出；G 成立随后就有。
hint.en: Prove first that G cannot be proved; that G holds follows.
